# @arki/chat-ui

> Chat and agent UI for React: styled assistant-ui primitives, tool call cards, thinking blocks, approval cards, step indicators and a renderer for @arki/ai runtime streams. Ships TSX source; needs Tailwind and a bundler.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/chat-ui/thread`: `ThreadEmpty`, `ThreadMessages`, `ThreadRoot`, `ThreadScrollToBottom`, `ThreadViewport`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/agent-panel`: `AgentPanel`; types `AgentPanelProps`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/runtime-conversation`: `RuntimeConversation`, `runtimeStatusToAgentStatus`; types `RuntimeConversationProps`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/message`: `AssistantMessage`, `AssistantMessageContent`, `MessageContent`, `SystemMessage`, `UserMessage`, `UserMessageContent`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/composer`: `Composer`, `ComposerAttachments`, `ComposerCancel`, `ComposerInput`, `ComposerSend`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/action-bar`: `ActionBar`, `ActionBarCopy`, `ActionBarEdit`, `ActionBarReload`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/branch-picker`: `BranchPicker`, `BranchPickerNext`, `BranchPickerPrevious`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/tool-call`: `ToolCall`, `ToolCallContent`, `ToolCallHeader`, `ToolCallResult`, `ToolCallStatusIcon`, `toolCallVariants`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/thinking-block`: `ThinkingBlock`, `ThinkingBlockReasoning`, `ThinkingBlockTrigger`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/approval-card`: `ApprovalActions`, `ApprovalCard`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/step-indicator`: `Step`, `StepIndicator`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/agent-status`: `AgentStatus`, `AgentStatusIcon`, `agentStatusVariants`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/code-block`: `CodeBlock`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/markdown-message`: `MarkdownMessage`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/tool-registry`: `ToolRegistryProvider`, `createToolRegistry`, `useToolRegistry`; types `ToolComponent`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/types`: Status of a tool call lifecycle. types `AgentStatusType`, `AgentStep`, `ApprovalAction`, `ApprovalResult`, `ToolCallMeta`, `ToolCallStatus`.
- `@arki/chat-ui/styles/chat.css`
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- Import `@arki/chat-ui/styles/chat.css` once, or the animations are missing.
- `useToolRegistry` throws outside `ToolRegistryProvider`.
- `Thread`, `Composer` and message parts need an assistant-ui runtime provider above them.
- `RuntimeConversation` prints text as is. Pass `renderText` for markdown.
- `RuntimeConversation` and `AgentPanel` need `RuntimeUiState` from `@arki/ai`.
